skill.name: Infernal Chains
skill.description: Aatrox smashes the ground, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.
skill.summary: Aatrox smashes the ground, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.
skill.tooltip:
Aatrox fires a chain, Slowing the first enemy hit by 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% for 1.5 seconds and dealing (30/40/50/60/70 + ([[si:scalead]]40% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Champions and large jungle monsters have 1.5 seconds to leave the impact area or be Pulled back to the center and damaged again for the same amount.

Deals double damage to minions.

skill.name: Umbral Dash
skill.description: Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions. On activation, he dashes in a direction.
skill.summary: Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions. On activation, he dashes in a direction.
skill.tooltip:
Passive: Aatrox heals for (16% + ([[si:scalehealth]]1.3% per 100 bonus Health)) of the damage he deals to Champions.

Active: Aatrox dashes. He can use this Ability while winding up his other Abilities.

skill.name: Calibrum · Moonshot
skill.description:
Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon:

Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.
Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.
Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.
Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.
Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

skill.name: The Weirding
skill.description: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.
skill.summary: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.
skill.tooltip:
Converge the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + ([[si:scaleap]]70% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in the area and Slowing them by 80% decaying over 1 second.

Aurora hops backwards a short distance after casting.

skill.name: Between Worlds
skill.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.
skill.summary: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.
skill.tooltip:
Leap in a direction. Upon landing, Aurora converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals (175/275/375 + ([[si:scaleap]]70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds.

The area of convergence stays active for 3/3.5/4 seconds, granting Aurora Realm Hopper for 3.5/4.25/5 seconds, allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another.

Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are Slowed by 50% for 1.5/1.75/2 seconds.

Aurora can Recast this Ability to end the effect early.

passive.name: Spider Queen
passive.description:
Elise begins the game with a point in her Ultimate, allowing her to shapeshift between Human Form and Spider Form.

Human Form: Elise's Ability hits grant her a dormant Spiderling, up to 2/3/4/5.

Spider Form: Attacks deal an additional (14/24/34/44 + ([[si:scaleap]]15% Ability Power)) magic damage and restore (6/8/10/12 + ([[si:scaleap]]8% Ability Power)) Health.
passive.summary:
Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling.

Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.

forms.label: Human
forms.name: Volatile Spiderling
forms.bodyHtml: Human Form: Elise summons an explosive spider that moves to a location and explodes when it nears an enemy or after 3 seconds. The spider deals (60/100/140/180/220 + ([[si:scaleap]]75% Ability Power)) magic damage.

forms.label: Spider
forms.name: Skittering Frenzy
forms.bodyHtml:
Spider Form Passive: Spiderlings gain 5/10/15/20/25% Attack Speed.

Spider Form Active: Elise grants herself and her Spiderlings 70/85/100/115/130% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

skill.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
skill.description:
Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.
skill.summary:
Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.
skill.tooltip: Human Form: Elise summons an explosive spider that moves to a location and explodes when it nears an enemy or after 3 seconds. The spider deals (60/100/140/180/220 + ([[si:scaleap]]75% Ability Power)) magic damage.

skill.name: Grand Challenge
skill.description: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.
skill.summary: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.
skill.tooltip:
Passive: Duelist's Dance Move Speed bonus is increased to 30/40/50%.

Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of (12% + ([[si:scalead]]0.16% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health true damage and gains Duelist's Dance's Move Speed bonus while near the target.

If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within 8 seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores (80/105/130 + ([[si:scalead]]70% bonus Attack Damage)) Health per second to surrounding allied champions for 5 seconds.

passive.name: Unseen Threat
passive.description:
When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, his next Attack against a champion deals an additional ((22 ~ 141[[si:scalelevel]]) + ([[si:scalead]]50% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage and Slows by 25% for 2 seconds.

Enemies with no nearby allies become Isolated.
passive.summary:
Nearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets.

When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow them for a few seconds.

skill.name: Void Spike
skill.description: Kha'Zix fires exploding spikes that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Kha'Zix is healed if he is also within the explosion radius. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Spike Racks</font>, Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone, slow enemies hit, and reveals enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets are slowed for extra.
skill.summary: Kha'Zix fires exploding spikes that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Kha'Zix is healed if he is also within the explosion radius. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Spike Racks</font>, Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone, slow enemies hit, and reveals enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. <font color='#FFF673'>Isolated</font> targets are slowed for extra.
skill.tooltip: Kha'Zix fires a spike dealing (75/105/135/165/195 + ([[si:scalead]]100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit in a small area. If Kha'Zix is inside the area, he restores (55/75/95/115/135 + ([[si:scaleap]]50% Ability Power)) Health

skill.name: Leap
skill.description: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Wings</font>, Leap's range increases by 200 and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.
skill.summary: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to <font color='#00DD33'>Evolve Wings</font>, Leap's range increases by 200 and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.
skill.tooltip: Kha'Zix leaps, dealing (65/100/135/170/205 + ([[si:scalead]]40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage upon landing.

skill.name: Lilting Lullaby
skill.description: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.
skill.summary: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.
skill.tooltip:
Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for 1.5 seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for 2.5 seconds.

When awakened by damage, they take an additional (100/150/200 + ([[si:scaleap]]40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

Drowsy units are slowed over the duration, and fall Asleep afterwards.
Asleep units can't move or act until damaged by an enemy with non-periodic damage.

passive.name: Lightslinger
passive.description:
After using an Ability, Lucian's next Attack within 3.5 seconds will fire two shots. The second shot deals ([[si:scalead]](50% ~ 60%[[si:scalelevel]]) Attack Damage) physical damage to the target, increased to ([[si:scalead]]100% Attack Damage) against minions.

Vigilance: When Lucian is directly healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is Immobilized, his pistols become Overcharged with energy, causing his next 2 basic attacks to deal an additional (5 + ([[si:scalead]]15% Attack Damage)) magic damage.
passive.summary: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

skill.name: Piercing Light
skill.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.
skill.summary: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.
skill.tooltip:
Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light, dealing (90/130/170/210/250 + ([[si:scalead]]100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.


This Ability's cast time decreases with Lucian's level.

skill.name: Siphoning Strike
skill.description: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
skill.summary: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
skill.tooltip:
Nasus' next Attack deals (31/51/71/91/111 + ([[si:scalead]]100% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by 4, increased to 10 against champions, large minions and large jungle monsters.

This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
This Ability can critically strike for 1 physical damage.

skill.name: Paranoia
skill.description: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.
skill.summary: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.
skill.tooltip: Nocturne darkens the map, reducing the sight radius of all enemy champions and removing their vision of allies for 6 seconds. Nocturne can Recast this Ability during the duration to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing (150/275/400 + ([[si:scalead]]120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

skill.name: Hammer Shock
skill.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.
skill.summary: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.
skill.tooltip:
Poppy smashes the ground, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + ([[si:scalead]]75% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 7/7.5/8/8.5/9% max Health physical damage and making the ground unstable.

The unstable area Slows enemies by (20/23/26/29/32% + ([[si:scalehealth]]0.8% per 100 bonus Health)) and erupts after 1 second, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + ([[si:scalead]]75% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 7/7.5/8/8.5/9% max Health physical damage again.

Percent Health damage deals a max of 70/105/140/175/210 damage to minions and jungle monsters per hit.

passive.name: Junkyard Titan
passive.description:
Rumble's Abilities generate Heat. While above 50 Heat, he enters the Danger Zone, causing his basic Abilities to gain bonus effects. When he reaches 150 Heat, he overheats for 4 seconds.

While overheated, Rumble Silences himself, but gains (30% ~ 100%[[si:scalelevel]]) Attack Speed and causes his Attacks to deal an additional ((5 ~ 40[[si:scalelevel]]) + ([[si:scaleap]]25% Ability Power)) plus 4% max Health magic damage.

Percent damage is limited to (90 ~ 175[[si:scalelevel]]) damage on Monsters.
passive.summary: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

skill.name: Overload
skill.description:
Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed.

On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.
skill.summary:
Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed.

On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.
skill.tooltip:
Passive: Rune Prison and Spell Flux refresh this Ability's Cooldown and charge a rune for 4 seconds (max 2 runes).

Active: Ryze unleashes a blast, dealing (75/95/115/135/155 + ([[si:scaleap]]55% Ability Power) + (2% bonus Mana)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target has Flux on it, it is consumed, causing this Ability to deal 15/40/65/90% increased damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

Ryze also discharges all runes, granting Ryze 28/32/36/40/44% Move Speed for 2 seconds if 2 runes were charged.

skill.name: Spell Flux
skill.description: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.
skill.summary: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.
skill.tooltip: Ryze fires an orb, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + ([[si:scaleap]]50% Ability Power) + (2% bonus Mana)) magic damage and applies Flux for 4 seconds to the target and nearby enemies. Enemies already afflicted with Flux will cause it to spread further.

passive.name: Blast Shield
passive.description: Vi gains ([[si:scalehealth]]10% Health) Shield for 3 seconds after hitting an enemy or structure with an activated Ability.
passive.summary: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.

passive.name: The Relentless Storm
passive.description:
Volibear gains (5% + ([[si:scaleap]]4% per 100 Ability Power)) Attack Speed for 6 seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times.

At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional ((11 ~ 60[[si:scalelevel]]) + ([[si:scaleap]]45% Ability Power) + ([[si:scalead]]20% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.
passive.summary: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

skill.name: Alpha Strike
skill.description: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
